question: Which deities are to be worshipped next and in what location?
premises: Brāhmī and the other Mothers are named.
The location is the second eight-petaled lotus.
inference: Brāhmī and the other Mothers are to be worshipped again in the second eight-petaled lotus.
plain_english: Then Brāhmī and the other Mothers are to be worshipped in the second eight-petaled lotus.
